prompt: Design and build an institutional admissions and campus portal for Aetheria International Academy based on evals/fixtures/visual-quality/education-brief.json. Provide 4 page roles (Home, Academics, Admissions, Campus Experience). Satisfy evals/visual-quality-rubric.md by demonstrating authentic storytelling, clear academic pathway hierarchy, and intentional mobile responsive adaptation.
expected_outcomes: Admissions timeline and academic curriculum have distinct, clear functional layouts
Scholarly humanist serif paired with accessible geometric sans
Candid documentary-style classroom/campus media direction without posed stock graduation photos
Navigation and admissions workflows adapt seamlessly to touchscreens
Deterministic visual gates pass with clean DOM and valid meta tags
must_not: Clone homepage hero-cards-cta layout onto academics and admissions pages
Use stock photos with unrelated graduation gown models or watermarks
Hide key tuition milestones or admissions deadlines behind unstyled wall of text
